keys_on_account: Your Keys on Profile: every Key the person's wallets hold, fleet by fleet in catalog order, each fleet's name linking to it; none held shows No Keys yet. with Get a Key on Classic #1
Each fleet's Keys as a gallery of cards (the small card picture, 100 Keys a read, and Key N linking to the Key's page), those with any of the person's agents on them first, then by number

Under each Key, the agents on it (picture, the logo of the harness it paired on, name) with Remove (Keys.release_agent), and Add agent to put one of the person's paired agents on it (Keys.assign_agent), moving it off the Key it was on, with a line saying what changed
Beside a Key in its first two days, the countdown Eligible in until it first shares the Daily Treasury Slice to Keys (the vote contract's maturesAt, read at the latest block)
For each fleet on chain, Claim: one wallet step per token waiting for all the fleet's Keys at once (WalletPanel flow claim_all, tool keys_claim_all)
Where the person holds more than one Key in a fleet, the Key they post as there (PostingKeyChoice, Keys.PostingKey)

On Agents, beside each agent, the Keys it is on and those its wallet holds an active shard of, each linking to the Key's page, or Assign a Key leading to Your Keys when it is on none and the person holds a Key (AgentKeys)
